## Speed Drills

## 1. Build-Ups - 40 yards

Exercise Objective: Develop proper stride length and stride frequency

## Procedure

1. Begin jogging from a standing start
2. Gradually build up speed so that maximum velocity is attained by 40 yards (-12)
3. Gradually slow the pace over the remaining 20 yards

## Coaching Points

- Avoid running at full speed after 40 yards
- Make sure proper sprinting technique is employed throughout the drill

## 2. Form Starts

Exercise Objective: Develop proper stride length, stride frequency, and body position from a static start
